text:
emma-partnerships: Quick check-in for CloudVendorY marketplace starter IAC. Partner wants a tiny deployable example (k8s inference + autoscaler + optional private VPC) and a short checklist for security review. Who can draft the repo layout + runbook?

rob-plat: I can do the repo skeleton. Proposed layout: modules/{network,cluster,inference,kms}, examples/{aws,gcp}, docs/{arch.md,runbook.md}, ci/{pipeline.yaml}. No provider blocks in modules. Keep variables consistent across clouds.

sasha-arch: Important constraints: support routing_mode (hosted|dedicated), kms_fallback boolean, and an option for node_pools with fixed instance types for latency-sensitive workloads. I'll sketch a compact diagram in docs/arch.md. Security checklist must include: artifact signing, minimal IAM roles, and vulnerability scan step for container images.

tom-terraform: I'll scaffold modules tomorrow. For each module add variables.tf, outputs.tf, README.md with usage, and a short example that wires them. Example top-level snippet to include:

```
module "network" {
  source = "../modules/network"
  name   = "cvy-net"
  region = var.region
}
module "cluster" {
  source     = "../modules/cluster"
  network_id = module.network.id
  cluster_name = "cvy-demo"
}
module "inference" {
  source       = "../modules/inference"
  cluster_name = module.cluster.name
  routing_mode = var.routing_mode
  enable_hsm   = var.enable_hsm
}
```

security-bot: Checklist template attached: https://internal.redwood/sec/checklists/marketplace-iac (ensure container scan + tfsec step) :white_check_mark:

emma-partnerships: Nice. Timeline: tom PR by EOD Wed, rob to add CI template, sasha to drop arch + security items in docs. We'll run partner walkthrough next week. Action items noted. :calendar:
